posts.name: Sean Patrick Fannon
posts.cooked:
Dear Handelabra,
 
I have extremely limited time that I can afford to play video games. What little time I have, I spend playing ~your~ game - your translation of my favorite tabletop game, Sentinels. As well, I encourage others to do the same.
 
Today, I am extremely sad and frustrated with your choice to diminish my support of your product by requiring me to jump through long, involved puzzle-solving hoops in order to "unlock" elements of the game I've been patiently waiting for since the day of the initial release.
 
For people like me, who only have so much time in their lives to devote to limited choices for entertainment, it would have been a great kindness and act of compassion to allow us to ~pay~ you for the additional content. If you want the social networking aspect of unlockable content, that's fine; just make both options available.
 
Let those of us willing to pay to get on with playing with the new toys do so, and let those who'd rather solve the puzzles to get the content free take that route.
 
Please consider this in the future for you other releases for this and other games.
 
Sincerely,
 
Sean Patrick Fannon
 
PS - Seriously, tell me where/how to send you money to get stuff unlocked for the current release and I am all over it!

posts.name: HeroComplex
posts.cooked:
Got Young Legacy unlocked!  Like people had guessed, it was about having Blade incap Legacy, but since that didn't work for others, there must have been more specific conditions that my game met.  To help with that, here's a quick info dump about what happened that unlocked her for me.

I stacked the fight to be as close as possible to what the wiki says about the fight where Legacy was killed, so it was at Wagner Mars Base and the rest of my team was Fanatic, Tachyon, and Tempest.  The actual damage that killed Legacy came from Blade, so you can't just have Tachyon Lightspeed Barrage him to take him out—though you can whittle down his health with other heroes so that he's prime for Blade's attack.  The variant unlocked immediately after Legacy's death, so it's not about beating Blade afterwards, it's just about Legacy being incapped.  It does not have to be on Advanced, mine was just a regular Blade.  Someone mentioned Next Evolution, given the art, and while I did have that out, I had not used the power at all during the game, so if it was relevant then it was presumably just about having the card in play when Legacy was incapped.  I don't know if it's significant, but the damage that killed Legacy was redirected to him through Lead From the Front, so if these other conditions aren't doing it for other players, it's possible that's important.  I wouldn't be surprised for any of those to be necessary/key to the unlock, as they all make thematic sense, but I'll have to leave it to others to test and see what works for them.  Good luck all!
